harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.notes: worker-start --model pin honoured. The two discovery probes are answered locally (num_turns 0, total_cost_usd 0, no model turn); do not treat them as a dispatch. Trust is a dialog. A fresh repository shows the trust dialog even with --dangerously-skip-permissions, with No, exit preselected, reproduced 2026-09-11 on Claude Code 2.1.268; a worktree of an already-trusted repository inherits trust and shows none, which is what the withdrawn 2026-09-04 probe actually measured — do not re-propose that 2026-09-04 reading. Claude Code 2.1.273 and 2.1.274 word the dialog 'Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?' with 'No, exit' preselected, so Enter refuses and exits the harness. Orca's prompt delivery sends Enter into that dialog, which is why a NO_ACK or PREFLIGHT FAIL quote on an untrusted path ends at a shell prompt and may hold only the tail 'Security guide' within the helper's 400-character quote (measured 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17).

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.limits: As Control, its shell may lack ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE (0.157.1); as a worker, 0.159.2 never passes Orca 1.4.215's readiness check.
harnesses.notes: Codex CLI 0.154.0 shows its own trust dialog on a fresh directory ('Do you trust the contents of this directory?'), measured 2026-09-16 during the 0.19.0 checklist; trust is dialog, not orca-preflight. Control wakes by waker. Discovery: slugs with visibility hide are not offered; effort levels are supported_reasoning_levels on each slug, not one vocabulary per harness. Native AGENTS.md reader; CLAUDE.md is inert (not imported). '› 1. Yes, continue' is preselected, so Enter grants trust (measured 2026-09-16 on 0.154.0). 2026-09-11, Orca 1.4.199: a gpt-5.6-terra medium Control slept, 3 turns for a two-worker cycle. 2026-09-16, 0.20.0 candidate: a gpt-5.6-sol high Control ended its turn after each wait-bg, one request per wait, and notify started a new turn. 2026-09-17, 0.20.0: a gpt-5.6-terra medium Control kept its turn open in 2 of 2 runs, looping orca terminal wait about every 35 s (6 requests in a 118 s wait); in one of them it launched dely wait-bg inside a new Orca terminal, so the waiter watched the wrong terminal and failed. A gpt-5.6-sol medium Control slept (requests only in the first 18 s of each wait, 3 turns). Whether a Codex Control sleeps is not a stable property of the model; record the Control model with each probe row. Codex's default model is now gpt-6-astra high, not measured as Control. 2026-09-29, Codex CLI 0.157.1 as Control: the wake worked, but its tool shell had no ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE, so the helper failed until the model found its own handle. 2026-09-30, Codex CLI 0.159.2 never passes Orca 1.4.215's worker readiness check: worker-start fails at agent_readiness after its 60 s timeout, with and without -c on its argv; Orca 1.4.215 recognises a ready Codex by the screen text OpenAI Codex followed by model: and directory:, and the 0.159.2 start screen shows neither label.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.limits: Every repository with AGENTS.md needs a per-path trust answer, and there is no model pin.
harnesses.notes: Grok Build 1.0.44 under Orca 1.4.215, measured 2026-09-29 (self-updated from 1.0.40 during the Spike). Control wakes by waker. On 1.0.44 every repository with AGENTS.md (every Dely repository) shows a per-path trust dialog ('Do you trust the contents of this directory?' keyed y/n); Orca detects it within about 2 s (agent-trust-workspace). A README-only fresh repo showed no dialog. Once trusted, implementer and reviewer both worked. Orca refuses --model. Grok validates root plugin.json (name and description only). PATH agent collides with this binary, so Cursor must not be documented as agent. Native AGENTS.md. A killed worker reaches attention.requiresAction within 1.5 s. Discovery is null: there is no launch-time pin.

harnesses.name: Antigravity CLI
harnesses.limits: The first launch on a new path can lose the prompt, and there is no effort pin.
harnesses.notes: Antigravity CLI 1.2.13 under Orca 1.4.215, measured 2026-09-29 (self-updated from 1.2.12 during the Spike). worker-start --agent agy returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is antigravity. Control wakes by waker. As implementer and reviewer it worked, but the first launch on a new path lost the prompt 3 of 4 times (0 of 6 once trusted). Orca accepts --model; --effort is rejected or silently drops the pin. Discovery: agy models (TSV, offer the slug column) — some slugs already end in -high/-medium/-low; do not strip those suffixes. Native AGENTS.md; do not offer GEMINI.md. Root plugin.json is the agy package (name and description only; additionalProperties false). Install is agy plugin install of the git URL or a local path; the CLI has no plugin update. Do not write ~/.gemini. A killed worker reaches attention.requiresAction within 1.5 s.

harnesses.name: Kiro CLI
harnesses.notes: Kiro CLI 2.21.0 under Orca 1.4.215, measured 2026-09-29. A worker never becomes ready: worker-start fails at agent_readiness after its 60 s timeout (3 of 3), with and without the trust-all confirmation answered, so the prompt is never delivered. worker-start --agent kiro-cli returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is kiro. Control wakes by waker via wait-bg, measured once, but only with a global confirmation setting (chat.disableTrustAllConfirmation) whose default exits. permissionDefault is none; --trust-all-tools is forbidden on the launch argv because it opens a confirmation whose default is No, exit, and Orca's Enter kills the session (measured on Orca 1.4.199). Once the TUI is idle, /tools trust-all was observed to trust tools for the session with no confirmation dialog. Headless kiro-cli chat --no-interactive is not a Dely worker. Native AGENTS.md. Discovery while supported was kiro-cli chat --list-models --format json (offer each model_id) and effort from kiro-cli chat --help; live 2.16.2 may offer only auto. Orca refuses --model. Install is npx skills targeting the kiro-cli agent at global scope. Do not write ~/.kiro or create custom agents.

harnesses.name: Cursor Agent CLI
harnesses.notes: worker-start --model pin honoured; omit --effort (there is no effort flag; write the literal default). worker-start --agent cursor-agent returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is cursor. Offer the model slug before ' - '. Do not invent an effort vocabulary, strip effort suffixes from slugs, or synthesize parameterized [effort=…] forms. Native AGENTS.md reader; the CLI also applies CLAUDE.md as a rule, so that file is not inert, but the import write offer stays on entries with needsImport. Never PATH agent (collides with Grok). Never -w/--worktree. Do not put --trust or an unpinned --sandbox on the launch argv. Trust dialog on a fresh directory, measured 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17 on Cursor Agent 2026.09.10-fd3934a and 2026.09.15-d2fe57e: '⚠ Workspace Trust Required … Do you trust the contents of this directory?' with '▶ [a] Trust this workspace' preselected over '[q] Quit', so `a` or Enter grants trust, and the screen shows '⏳ Trusting workspace...' before the composer. Text sent in that state was dropped while `orca terminal send` returned ok; wait for the composer before sending a prompt.

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
harnesses.limits: Orca does not detect its trust dialog (seen only as NO_ACK, once per path); there is no model pin, and prompts are occasionally left unsent.
harnesses.notes: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.89 under Orca 1.4.215, measured 2026-09-29 (self-updated from 1.0.83 during the Spike). Control wakes by background. The per-path trust dialog ('Confirm folder trust … Do you trust the files in this folder?' with 1. Yes preselected; option 2 remembers the folder) is not detected by Orca: worker-start returns input_accepted, and the helper sees only NO_ACK after 60 s. Restore interrupted sessions then lists sessions from other folders; Esc starts fresh, Enter is a wrong-session hazard. Once trusted, implementer and reviewer both worked; 2 of 7 launches left the prompt unsent. Orca refuses --model. --allow-all is the documented equivalent of --allow-all-tools --allow-all-paths --allow-all-urls, with --yolo as its alias (Orca's default). No non-interactive model listing: copilot models fails with Invalid command format; copilot -p "/model" dispatched a real turn. Native AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md reader (--no-custom-instructions disables both). A killed worker reaches attention.requiresAction within 1.5 s. Install uses existing manifests into ~/.copilot/installed-plugins/dely/dely/; no sidecar.

harnesses.name: OMP
harnesses.limits: A dead worker surfaces only at STALLED.
harnesses.notes: OMP 18.3.3 under Orca 1.4.212, measured 2026-09-27. worker-start --agent omp --model is refused: 'Agent omp does not support launch-time model selection'; the pin travels as a spec line `dely-pin: <selector>` or `dely-pin: <selector> <effort>` that extensions/dely-pin.ts applies on the first before_agent_start. Trust is none: OMP has no workspace-trust gate, so a repository's `.omp/extensions`, `.omp/skills` and `.omp/config.yml` take effect without a prompt; a worker showed no trust dialog and wrote a file without an approval prompt. Approvals follow the user's `tools.approvalMode` (defaults to yolo). Control wakes by waker; bash runs as an async job (timeout default 300 s, max 3600 s, equal to dely wait's default 60 min); a full 0.20.1 wait-bg cycle with a Claude Code worker settled end to end. A killed OMP worker keeps liveness.verdict live (source agent_status), nextAction none and attention.requiresAction false for at least six minutes, so dely wait reaches STALLED after --stall-min, not ATTENTION. Install is omp plugin install of a local checkout (package.json pi.extensions and pi.skills); the dely marketplace does not load the extension. An unresolvable pin must process.exit: throw is swallowed and the turn runs on the default model; ctx.shutdown() lets the turn finish, worker_done included. The level check sets the level and reads it back with getThinkingLevel() rather than reading registry shapes. Discovery: omp models --json, offer selector, effort from thinking.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.limits: As Control, run the helper with no tool timeout; the pin is unchecked.

discovery.effort: pi --help | sed -n 's/.*--thinking <level> *Set thinking level: //p' | tr -d ' ' | tr ',' '\n'

harnesses.notes: Pi 0.87.1 under Orca 1.4.215, measured 2026-09-28. worker-start --agent pi --model is refused: 'Agent pi does not support launch-time model selection'; the pin travels as a spec line `dely-pin: <selector>` or `dely-pin: <selector> <effort>` that extensions/dely-pin.ts applies on the first before_agent_start. Orca reports neither the model (projection.provider has model: null) nor a transcript (worker-read returns provider_unsupported and falls back to terminal). modelPin is spec-unchecked so dispatch skips the projection check. Trust is a dialog ('Trust project folder?' with Trust preselected), shown only when the directory or an ancestor holds .pi/ (settings.json, extensions, skills, prompts, themes, SYSTEM.md) or .agents/skills; a clean repository shows no dialog. Orca passes the prompt on the command line, so a worker held by the trust dialog never acknowledges. A worker has no approval step and wrote files without a prompt. Killing its process sets attention.requiresAction true within 3 s, so dely wait reaches ATTENTION. Control wakes by waker; a full dely wait-bg cycle settled. Pi's bash tool runs commands under a model-chosen timeout (10 s, 20 s and 30 s were seen), which killed `dely preflight` and `dely dispatch` mid-command in 2 of 6 Pi Control sessions; a Pi Control must not run the helper under a timeout shorter than `ACK_S` (60 s) plus the pin check for `dispatch`, or `PREFLIGHT_S` (150 s) for `preflight`. Install is pi install git:github.com/hieuphung97/dely@v<version> or pi install of a local path (Pi also loads a package's extensions/ and skills/ directories by convention, whatever the key; the package.json pi key is what OMP reads). The extension sets the level and reads it back via getThinkingLevel(), failing on mismatch. A Model or Effort cell containing whitespace fails open on Pi. Discovery: models via pi --list-models, effort levels via pi --help.
